Volt Typhoon 2022-2023 (China): Chinese state actors pre-positioned in US critical infrastructure (power, water, communications) per CISA/FBI/NSA joint advisory. Russian cyberattacks on US state election infrastructure ongoing.
pre_covid_who_pandemic_description: Mpox (monkeypox) PHEIC declared July 23, 2022: WHO declared global health emergency for 2022-2023 mpox outbreak affecting 75+ countries (17,000+ cases). PHEIC ended May 2023. Second mpox PHEIC declared Aug 14, 2024 for Clade I variant in Africa. Both PHEICs active in the prior 4 years before 2024 election.

china_aggression_description: China conducted large-scale blockade-simulation military exercises around Taiwan in August 2022 (after Pelosi visit), May 2024 (Joint Sword-2024A, after Taiwan's presidential inauguration), and October 2024 (Joint Sword-2024B); also continued aggressive operations against Philippine vessels in South China Sea including use of water cannons and ship collisions.
